source: Independently written runtime and declarations informed by upstream contracts. The original MIT license and hash-pinned tests are retained; no upstream runtime is shipped.

implementation.targetScope: Single-entry memoization, clear, custom equality and receiver identity; react-window 1.8.11 caller using memoize-one 5.2.1.

changes: Clear during function evaluation prevents that evaluation from repopulating the cache.
Clear from a custom equality function causes a miss rather than a TypeError.
Reentrant equality retains the result associated with the arguments actually compared.

verification.originalTests: All 78 runtime tests on Node24/Bun, using Mocha and the official Jest mock/expect libraries; TypeScript syntax erased, original imports redirected, assertions unchanged.
verification.caller: Actual react-window1.8.11 mounted with React19.1, against 5.2.1,6.0.0 and VPM.
verification.regressions: Six groups, three original-failure controls and 4000 differential calls.
